answer: A horizon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the terrace of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the ember of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
